note: AI draft for faculty review. Reaction trust_step is multiplied by state_rules.reaction_trust_unit.

reactions.description: No strong reaction to this line.
Feels heard; the doctor got it right.
A small sense that things could get better.
reactions.example: You think it can get better?

reactions.description: Tension drops; it was easier to say than feared.
Feels liked and safe with this doctor.
Settled; nothing in the line threatens.
Unsure of the doctor; holds back.
reactions.example: Why do you want to know?

reactions.description: Caught off guard by a direct or sudden question.
Fears what the answer means or what happens next.
Feels judged or exposed; wants to hide.
Embarrassed about how they look or sound.
Painful feeling rises; may tear up.
Feels little; answers from a distance.
Feels the doctor got it wrong or dismissed them.

behaviours.description: Answers the question directly and honestly.
behaviours.example: I wake up around four and can't sleep again.

behaviours.description: Plays it down as small or normal.
Says no to something that is true.
Moves away from the topic or turns it back.
Cannot or will not give clear times.
Answers a nearby, safer question instead.
Drifts to a loosely linked topic.
behaviours.example: My flatmate also doesn't sleep, she watches shows.

behaviours.description: Irritable or sharp with the doctor.
Shares something painful and becomes tearful.
behaviours.example: Some nights I wish I just wouldn't wake up.

behaviours.description: Answers with a question of their own.
Goes along on the surface but gives nothing real.

resistance.example: Can we talk about something else?

resistance.description: Talks in a way that blocks closeness: jokes, intellectualises, over-polite.
resistance.example: Haha, I'm fine, really, don't worry.
